core.title: Aluminum S Shutter Dogs, Acorn AK4BQ

text.description_html:
Acorn AK4BQ, Black Aluminum "S" Shutter Dogs

The Acorn made Black Aluminum "S" Shutter Dogs are a beautiful way to add old world charm to any home. Shutter dogs are used as fasteners to hold open window shutters. As lovely as these shutter dogs are, they will be sure to increase your home's curb side appeal. They are made of high tensile aluminum alloy and finished with in matte black for a truly traditional appearance. They can be mounted in wood and brick and come packaged as a pair (one for each shutter).

Specifications and Features of the Aluminum "S" Shutter Dogs:

  • Material: High tensile aluminum alloy.
  • Finish: Black
  • Length: 6-3/4"
  • Width: 2-3/8"
  • Stainless Steel Lag Screw: 4" x 3/8"
  • Comes packaged with 2 shutter dogs, 2 lag screws, and 2 anti-rattle hooks.

Priced and sold in pairs (2 shutter dogs).
